written_before_any_run: Committed before the code or any run. These experiments choose the v2 shortlist. They do not freeze the v2 winner: that happens later, by a rule committed before the v2 tuning.
data: Development split only: the same 4,882 rows with a floor area and the same five group folds. Calibration and the final test are not read.
inputs: The five inputs plus the Eircode routing key, as in the current v2 candidate.

references.note: CV MAPE with the Eircode key and the v1 tuned settings, from the earlier experiments. Re-measured in the run so every number is on the same rows.

bagging.what: Average several seeds of one model in log-price: HistGradientBoosting x10, CatBoost x10, MLP x5, using the v1 tuned settings with different random seeds.
bagging.also: Equal average of the three models, each bagged, against the same average with one seed each.

gpboost.what: Boosting on the five inputs plus grouped random effects for county and routing key (crossed), Gaussian likelihood on log price. The routing key is NOT a fixed input here: its effect comes from the random effect.
gpboost.rounds: chosen by cross-validation inside each outer training set only (never on the scored fold)
gpboost.rare_keys: also report MAPE on scored homes whose routing key has fewer than 10 training rows, where pooling is claimed to help

tabpfn.what: TabPFNRegressor on log price with the five inputs and the routing key as a categorical code, default settings, no tuning.
tabpfn.weights: The model weights are downloaded only after the owner agrees. The report records the licence and where they came from.

shortlist_rule.rule: A variant enters the v2 shortlist only if ALL hold: (1) its CV MAPE is at least 0.5 points below the best single reference (CatBoost, 21.78); (2) it is lower than that reference in all five folds; (3) its median over or under estimate is within plus or minus 2%, so it does not win by estimating low; (4) its within-10% share is not worse than the reference's.
shortlist_rule.why_0_5: These experiments only choose the shortlist, so the bar is half the 1-point bar used for freezing a winner. The 1-point rule and the tie band are applied later, after tuning, with rules committed first.

also_report: MdAPE, within 10%, MAE, R2, fit and predict time, number of models and new dependencies, and for TabPFN the licence.
nothing_else_changes: The frozen v1 model and its final test are untouched.
